intro: Ma Stonefield is a human matriarch residing at the Stonefield Farm in western Elwynn Forest. Standing right outside the family homestead alongside Auntie Bernice, she deals with the daily hardships of rural farm life amidst neighboring rivalries and pest troubles.

p: Standing beside her family cottage in southwestern Elwynn Forest, Ma Stonefield watches over the farmstead alongside "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield. Life between the neighboring Maclure homestead and the nearby pumpkin patches is rarely peaceful. Local wild boars continuously threaten the family crops, and none poses a greater nuisance than Princess, an enormous prize sow notorious for trampling fields and devouring hard-earned harvests.
